meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取、检查和写入流式细胞术FCS文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理FCS格式的流式细胞术数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry FCS files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能读取 FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 文件，解析版本、事件数、通道名等元数据，把事件数据转成 NumPy 数组或 CSV，也能从数组创建新的 FCS 文件。
howto.when: 当用户需要读写 FCS 文件、提取元数据和通道信息、把事件数据转成 NumPy 数组或 CSV 等时触发。

say.text: 读取 sample.fcs，告诉我它的版本、事件数和通道名。
say.note: Claude 会用 FlowIO 解析并返回基本信息。

say.text: 把 sample.fcs 的事件数据转成 CSV 文件。
say.note: Claude 会提取事件数据并导出 CSV。

say.text: 用这个事件数据数组创建 FCS 3.1 文件。
say.note: Claude 会用 create_fcs 生成新文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 files, parse metadata like version, event count, and channel names, extract event data as NumPy arrays or CSV, and create new FCS files from arrays.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user needs to read or write FCS files, extract metadata and channel information, or convert event data to NumPy arrays or CSV, etc.

say_en.text: Read sample.fcs and tell me its version, event count, and channel names.
say_en.note: Claude will parse it with FlowIO and return basic info.

say_en.text: Convert the event data from sample.fcs to a CSV file.
say_en.note: Claude will extract event data and export CSV.

say_en.text: Create an FCS 3.1 file from this event data array.
say_en.note: Claude will use create_fcs to generate a new file.
